metadata.description: Schema-derived placeholder, not a live capture (paged GetBaselineDeviceSummaryResponseV1Model wrapper: page/pageSize/total/results -- NOT SearchResult): a genuine live capture was not possible when this was written -- the test tenant had no baseline available at that moment and no enrolled device -- NOT because the API lacks a create route: it does (resources/baseline_creator.go's BaselineCreator.Create, POST /api/mdm/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/baselines, genuinely live-captured as baselines/create-response.json, ledger verified[12]).
